title: Annual leave
text: Employees receive 25 days of annual leave per calendar year. Up to 5 unused days carry over to March 31 of the next year. Leave of more than 10 consecutive working days needs manager approval 30 days in advance.

title: Parental leave
text: Birth and adoptive parents receive 26 weeks of paid parental leave, taken in up to three blocks within 18 months. Notify People Operations at least 8 weeks before the first block.

title: Expense limits for client dinners
text: Client dinners are reimbursed up to 4,000 rupees per attendee including tax. Alcohol is reimbursed only when a client is present. Submit itemised receipts within 30 days.

title: Travel booking
text: Book flights through the travel portal at least 14 days ahead where possible. Economy class applies to flights under 6 hours. Hotel nightly caps depend on city tier and are listed in the portal.

title: Laptop security
text: Company laptops must use full-disk encryption, automatic screen lock after 5 minutes and the managed endpoint agent. Report a lost device to the security desk within 1 hour.

title: Incident severity levels
text: SEV1: customer data exposed or the platform unavailable for all customers. SEV2: a major feature unavailable or data at risk for one customer. SEV3: degraded performance with a workaround.

title: Production access
text: Production access is granted just in time for up to 4 hours, through the access portal, with a linked ticket. Standing production access is not permitted for any role.

title: Customer data retention
text: Customer content is deleted 30 days after contract end unless a legal hold applies. Backups expire after 35 days. Deletion certificates are issued on request.

title: Refund policy for annual plans
text: Annual plans can be refunded pro rata within the first 60 days. After 60 days, refunds need a director's approval and are given as account credit, not cash.

title: Service credits
text: If monthly availability falls below 99.9%, customers receive a service credit: 10% of the monthly fee below 99.9%, 25% below 99.0%. Credits must be requested within 30 days.

title: Data export
text: Admins can export workspace data as JSON or CSV from Settings, Data, Export. Exports over 5 GB are delivered as a download link that expires after 7 days.

title: Single sign-on setup
text: Workspaces on the Business plan can enable SAML single sign-on. After enabling it, password login is disabled for all members except two break-glass admins.

title: API rate limits
text: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace and 60 per minute per token. Responses over the limit return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

title: Audit log
text: The audit log records sign-ins, permission changes, exports and API token creation. Entries are kept for 400 days and can be streamed to a customer's own storage.

title: Salary bands
text: Salary bands are reviewed every April. Band documents are restricted to People Operations and leadership and must not be shared with other staff.

title: Reorganisation plan (draft)
text: Draft plan for the next financial year. Restricted to the leadership group until it is announced.
